description: Add a typed, directed edge between two existing concepts by editing the `from` note's frontmatter (e.g. lead-scoring depends_on contact-model). Use when you notice a relationship the vault is missing. Both concepts should already exist; use upsert_concept first if not.

from.description: Source concept id (its file gains the relation).

relation.description: Edge type, e.g. part_of | realized_by | governs | depends_on | constrains | supersedes | related_to (default). Domain→domain links (related_to / depends_on) are encouraged where two domains share a boundary, so the graph shows how areas overlap.

name: link_concepts
title: Link concepts
